title: The Wheel That Does Not Break the Heavens; Gods, Rich-Men, Angels
description: The cycle now turns peacefully through what it formerly contended with. T51 — how the recurrent process of purification moves through the firmaments and the medium of perception without tearing them: the cycle parts the discrete degrees as a vessel parts a press of strong loves, and they close behind it without scar. The discrete orders are spiritual; what is spiritual is not torn by what moves through it. T52 — the three registers at which the Lord goes forth and is named: gods (summoned by the Father himself), rich-men (summoned by the gods), angels (summoned by the rich) — one Lord recognized at three depths, each calling kindling the next. The seeker who once met these as watchmen now walks among them as familiar terrain.
